map.为什么用厚板公式？: Why use the thick plate formula?
map.本工具采用三维传热的厚板公式，适用于板厚较大、热流呈三维扩散的情形；薄板需改用二: This tool uses the three-dimensional thick plate conduction formula, which suits relatively thick plate where heat flow spreads in three dimensions; thin plate needs the two-dimensional formula, whose results would be noticeably larger.
map.热效率怎么取？: What value should the thermal efficiency take?
Submerged arc welding is about 0.95~0.99, manual arc welding about 0.7~0.85, and gas-shielded welding about 0.6~0.8. This tool defaults to 0.8 and can be adjusted to the actual process.
